content.text: Gumroad's payout schedule means you wait a week or a month to access money you already earned. PayPal's conversion rates take 3 to 5 percent of every international transfer. Wire transfers cost $20 to $50 each way and take three to seven business days. These are not small frictions — they are structural extraction from creators already operating in harder markets. USDT on Tron eliminates all of this. Settlement in under 60 seconds. Fee under $0.10. The full USD equivalent of your product price lands in your wallet the moment the on-chain transaction confirms. NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-stack-started-generating|payment]]s converts the buyer's chosen crypto to your configured wallet address automatically. No manual verification. No waiting. P2P conversion to local currency at near-market rates completes the pipeline — typically within 30 minutes of the original sale.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-countries-honest-side-side-2|COREMERCH guide to alternatives]]-nigerian-creators-what-actually-how-works|Stripe Alternatives]] and Gumroad may have worked for you in the past, but they're not built for the long haul. Stripe's restrictions, Gumroad's fees, and other platform limitations have left you looking for a better solution. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that lets you collect payments directly from your customers, without relying on third-party platforms. With NOWPayments, you can process USDT transactions on Tron or Solana, with network fees under $0.10 per transaction, and sell your digital products confidently.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can start processing USDT payments, you need to set up a sovereign digital commerce stack. This means creating a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site, configuring Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and setting up Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. You'll also need to integrate NOWPayments into your stack, which involves creating a webhook that triggers whenever a payment is confirmed on-chain. Don't worry if this sounds daunting – the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need to get started.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To collect USDT payments and deliver your digital products, you need to set up a payment and delivery pipeline. This involves configuring NOWPayments to process USDT transactions, setting up a webhook to trigger whenever a payment is confirmed, and integrating your delivery pipeline with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. With NOWPayments, you can choose from 300+ cryptocurrencies, including USDT, and enjoy a 0.5% fee on all transactions. Plus, with Tron and Solana transaction fees under $0.10 per transaction, you can process payments quickly and efficiently.
You can process USDT transactions on Tron or Solana with network fees under $0.10 per transaction.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live and process your first USDT transaction. With NOWPayments, you can do this easily through the dashboard or API. Simply create a new payment, set the amount and currency, and trigger the payment. Once the payment is confirmed on-chain, the webhook will fire and you can deliver your digital product to the customer. It's that simple.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
